payload.title: The Blanket Has a Corner
payload.payoff: Arda lifts the hidden fold and the blanket opens into a neat, unmistakable star shape across the sofa; its star-shaped shadow finally matches.
payload.concept: Visual discovery: Arda tries to fold a blanket, but its shadow reveals a shape the blanket itself does not seem to have.
payload.discovery: The pointed shadow is cast by a real fold tucked beneath the blanket, changing the apparent impossibility into a clue about its shape.
payload.impossibleRule: Only the blanket’s shadow accurately shows its concealed folded shape.
payload.productionRisk: Keep the shadow aligned with the blanket and rug; avoid extra folds that obscure the single visual clue.
payload.viewerQuestion: Where is the pointed corner coming from?
payload.firstStaticFrame: In a warm, lived-in 3D cartoon living room, Arda holds a rumpled blanket over a sofa. Its shadow on the patterned rug has one sharply pointed corner, though every visible blanket corner is rounded.
payload.frameZeroProblem: The blanket’s shadow shows a pointed corner Arda cannot see on the blanket.
payload.proposedProgression: Arda turns the blanket, but the pointed shadow stays tied to one concealed fold; following the shadow directs Arda’s hand beneath the fabric; opening that fold reveals the full star shape.

payload.title: The Heavy Feather Pillow
payload.payoff: With the pillow resting in place, the sofa cushions curl up around it into a tall, snug throne; Arda perches visibly above the original seat height.
payload.concept: Expectation reversal: Arda expects a pillow to sink into a sofa cushion, but the sofa sinks away from the pillow.
payload.discovery: The pillow is not unusually heavy: its presence makes nearby upholstery rise toward it, reversing the expected direction of a cushion’s dip.
payload.everydayGoal: Make a comfortable place to sit.
payload.impossibleRule: Sofa upholstery moves toward this pillow rather than compressing away from it.
payload.productionRisk: Limit deformation to the sofa cushions and keep the pillow’s position clear so the reversed motion reads immediately.
payload.viewerQuestion: Why is the sofa moving toward a pillow that has not touched it?
payload.firstStaticFrame: In a cozy 3D cartoon home with a knitted throw and a worn sofa, Arda holds one plump pillow above an empty seat whose cushion is already dipping upward toward it.
payload.frameZeroProblem: The seat deforms before Arda can put the pillow down.
payload.proposedProgression: The empty cushion bulges toward the hovering pillow; the armrests lean inward as Arda lowers it; the settled pillow draws the upholstery into an elevated seat.

payload.title: One Small Tablecloth
payload.payoff: Arda chooses to wrap the cloth around the chair; it unfolds into a generous, plush seat, while the uncovered table remains plain and intact. Arda sits comfortably in the transformed chair.
payload.concept: Consequential choice: Arda must decide whether to keep a table neatly set or give its cloth to a chilly-looking chair.
payload.discovery: Wherever the tablecloth rests, the furniture beneath it visibly relaxes and rounds out; the chair’s hunched shape is not damage but a response to being uncovered.
payload.everydayGoal: Prepare a comfortable spot for a quiet meal.
payload.impossibleRule: Furniture covered by this tablecloth becomes plush and relaxed; uncovered furniture keeps its ordinary shape.
payload.productionRisk: Keep the furniture deformation simple and the cloth as the only transferring object; avoid making the chair appear alive.
payload.viewerQuestion: Why does the chair seem cold beside a neatly dressed table?
payload.firstStaticFrame: In a warm, lived-in 3D cartoon dining nook, Arda stands beside a set table. One tablecloth drapes neatly over it, while a bare chair beside the table curls its back inward like a shivering shoulder.
payload.frameZeroProblem: The table looks ready, but the only chair is tightly curled and unusable.
payload.proposedProgression: Arda notices the chair’s inward curl while the covered table appears unusually cushioned; lifting one cloth edge makes the table firm as the chair’s nearest edge softens; moving the cloth fully onto the chair restores a usable seat at the cost of the dressed table.
